metrics.metric: Company performance (financial and non-financial metrics, absolute and relative)
metrics.evidence: The HRC assessed our Company performance at 75% with 100% representing achievement of expected Company performance levels by the HRC.

2019 annual incentives for named executives were determined by the HRC after considering a holistic performance assessment based on Company performance, individual performance, and risk management performance.
Risk Management Reflects progress each named executive made against risk management specific to their roles and business/function.

metrics.metric: EPS of at least $3.00 or RORCE of at least median of Financial Performance Peer Group (annual incentive precondition)
metrics.evidence: one of the following goals must have been met: (1) EPS of at least $3.00 or (2) Return on Realized Common Equity (RORCE) of at least the median of the Financial Performance Peer Group.
The number of Performance Shares earned at the end of the performance period depends on the achievement of average three-year ROTCE, on an absolute and relative basis.

In order for an award to pay above 125% of target, our relative Total Shareholder Return (TSR) for the performance period must be in the top quartile of the specified Financial Performance Peer Group.
For any year in the three-year performance period that our Company incurs a Net Operating Loss (NOL), the target number of Performance Shares will be reduced by one-third.

metrics.metric: Failure to make progress on regulatory matters (performance share adjustment)
metrics.evidence: Subject to downward adjustment by HRC under a wide variety of circumstances: Reduction for failure to make progress on regulatory matters.
